lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into approximately 10-12 discernible vertical columns. The largest clusters are concentrated along the horizontal midline of the flank, with cluster diameter decreasing towards the dorsal and ventral margins.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the high-luminance circular clusters, forming a structured grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral region of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank. These features are defined by a high-intensity luminance gradient on the dorsal side and a corresponding shadow-induced low-intensity region on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, high-luminance sub-objects positioned in the immediate proximity of the primary object's pectoral fin and ventral surface, indicating associated organisms.
